text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess called me out today,
so I headed up to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...*inhale*... *exhale*...
And if Trainer were to come along after this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait!
This is way ahead of schedule!
A-At this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Take 2, here we go~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――TAKE2。

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...So you've arrived,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Umm...... excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-T-Today is,
um... err...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...What was my next line again?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Take 3, here we go~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...*ahem*!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...There you are,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Do you know what day it is today?
It's that sweet, special time in February..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! Yes, it's Valentine's Day!
So please, won't you—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please accept this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A blushing Kawakami Princess handed me a cutely wrapped box.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You're very welcome!
S-So, um..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um... about that chocolate just now...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Did I present it properly,
according to Valentine's etiquette?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I did lots of research!
Just to make sure we could spend Valentine's properly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
First, each type of Valentine's treat
apparently has a meaning behind giving it.
And there's the right timing to give it, too?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Elegance is refined through proper conduct, after all.
I wanted to start properly, even with gifts for those close to me...
choice_data_list: You really didn't need to worry about that.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if I don't do that,
then they won't truly be able to enjoy it...
choice_data_list: Just knowing you feel that way is more than enough to make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! O-Of course!
Go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I opened the package Kawakami Princess gave me to find chocolates from a famous shop often talked about on the internet.
choice_data_list: ...You really prepared a lot for this, huh.
...You really prepared a lot for this, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It's just, I really wanted to make
you happy, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with Kawakami Princess watching over me,
I stuffed my mouth with chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Ah!? Wait, hold on a moment!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"There's just one last thing.
Um... something I would really like to do."
choice_data_list: Is that also part of manners?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No... this wasn't written
in the manners guide, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "U-Um... they say the secret to making handmade chocolate delicious is putting your heart into it."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I put my heart into it while making it, but...
I'm anxious about whether it actually turned out delicious.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Before you eat it, may I put my feelings
into the chocolate one more time?
I apologize, as I know this goes against proper etiquette, but...
choice_data_list: Of course, could I ask you to?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
*gasp*... Please! Let it be chocolate!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Delicious, delicious, make it so~,
taste the best and steal the show...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well then... go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by an unusually nervous Kawakami Princess,
I take a cupcake out of the box
and take a bite.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *G-Gulp...*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's probably not used to cooking.
The bitter char and the sweetness of unmixed sugar
take turns hitting my palate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still—
choice_data_list: I can tell you put so much feeling into it—it's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! Oh my, really?!
Ehehe... I'm so glad you like it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. I prepared a return gift for her
and handed it over.
